meta.title: Pricing | Free for Founding Members, Pay-As-You-Go and Puntr Pro
meta.description: Puntr is free for the first 100 Founding Members. Pay-As-You-Go credits and Puntr Pro (R99 per month) are coming later. Posting and the leaderboard are always free.
meta.ogTitle: Puntr pricing: free for Founding Members
meta.ogDescription: Claim one of 100 Founding spots. Posting, voting and the leaderboard are always free.

title: Pricing
subtitle: Free for the first 100 Founding Members. Pay-As-You-Go and Puntr Pro come later and are entirely optional.

founding.title: Founding Members: free
founding.f1: A permanent Founding badge, numbered #1 to #100
founding.f2: Full access to posting, your record and the weekly leaderboard
founding.f3: 30 free Pay-As-You-Go credits a month for 3 months once they launch

never: Paying never earns extra points, a higher ranking or prize eligibility.

faq.title: Pricing questions
faq.a1: Yes. Founding Members use Puntr free. Posting, voting and the leaderboard are always free.
faq.q2: When do Pay-As-You-Go and Puntr Pro launch?
faq.a2: Not at launch. We will announce prices and terms before anything goes on sale. The prices here are indicative.
faq.q3: What is the difference between Pay-As-You-Go and Puntr Pro?
faq.a3: Pay-As-You-Go lets you buy credits when you need them. Puntr Pro is one monthly subscription, R99 per month, for advanced bettors and tipsters who use Puntr every week.
faq.a4: No. Paying never earns extra points or prize eligibility. Credits and Puntr Pro only unlock optional extras.
faq.a5: No. Puntr does not take bets, set odds or hold betting funds.

payg.title: Pay-As-You-Go
payg.tagline: Buy credits only when you need them. No subscription.
payg.note: Indicative prices. They may change before launch.
payg.alwaysFree: Posting, voting and the leaderboard are always free.

pro.title: Puntr Pro
pro.tagline: For advanced bettors and tipsters who want deeper analysis.
pro.note: One simple monthly subscription. Not on sale yet: we will publish the full terms and cancellation rules before it opens.
pro.f1: <1>AI-Powered Insights</1>: match previews and slip checks
pro.f2: Advanced tipster analytics: units, ROI and form by market, sport and odds range
pro.f3: Custom alerts for fixtures and settled picks you follow
pro.f5: A Pro badge on your profile
pro.fine: Pro never changes your ranking, points or prize eligibility.
